punchline: Walton restarted in a smaller town with a newer way of selling.
thirty_sec: After losing Newport, Sam Walton moved to Bentonville in May 1950, bought the Harrison Variety store with his father-in-law's help and ran it as Walton's 5 & 10, among the first self-service variety stores in the country.
question: If you restarted next week with the same skills, which new method would you try first?
key_contrast: Keep the craft, change one part of the method.
